DEFINITIVE.description: R1-R4 satisfied, intervention confirmed via CID W1

stages.description: Collect telemetry from Prometheus (metrics) and Jaeger (traces)
stages.input: PrometheusClient endpoint or MockTelemetry; list of service IDs; observation window in seconds
stages.output: Dict[service_id -> DataFrame(columns=['time','value'])] containing raw metric time series
stages.latency_target: Wall-clock ~2-5s per scrape cycle (Prometheus 15s default interval)
stages.validation_check: len(metrics) == len(services) AND each DataFrame is non-empty AND live_telemetry_used=True
stages.notes: BLOCKED on macOS without running cluster. Raises NotImplementedError when no Prometheus endpoint is reachable.

stages.description: Z-score anomaly detection over Δt=10s time windows to identify anomalous services
stages.input: Raw metric DataFrames from OBSERVE; per-service baseline statistics (mean, std)
stages.output: Dict[service_id -> z_score_max]; set of anomalous services exceeding theta_detect=3.0
stages.validation_check: At least one service with z_score > theta_detect=3.0; pipeline returns PASS with no anomalies detected
stages.notes: theta_detect=3.0 sigma default; configurable. Baseline derived from first half of observation window if not provided.

stages.description: Build time-sliced causal graph G_T with Δt=10s windows; guarantees acyclicity by construction
stages.input: Raw metric DataFrames; call graph topology (nx.DiGraph); TimeSliceConfig(delta_t=10.0)
stages.output: TimeSlicedGraph with nodes (service, t) and forward-only temporal edges; collapsed service graph
stages.validation_check: tsg.is_acyclic() == True; all edges are strictly forward in time (lag >= 1)
stages.notes: Δt must satisfy: Δt >= 2×p99_inter_service_latency AND Δt <= min_anomaly_duration

stages.description: Construct anomaly subgraph via Adaptive Expansion Strategy D (1-hop ancestor + bidirected expansion); enforce k<=15
stages.input: Anomaly scores from ANOMALY_DETECTION; collapsed service graph from TIME_SLICED_GT; PAG bidirected pairs (if available)
stages.output: AnomalySubgraphResult with subgraph_services (k<=15), boundary_limited flag, pruned_services list
stages.validation_check: k <= 15; boundary_limited=True iff k was pruned; false_attribution_rate=0.00 on synthetic cases A-F

algorithm.step2: 1-hop ancestor closure: add direct parents in G_T
algorithm.step3: Bidirected expansion: add both endpoints of bidirected PAG edges
algorithm.step4: k<=15 enforcement: prune by anomaly score if over limit

stages.description: Run Fast Causal Inference (FCI) on anomaly subgraph data to produce a Partial Ancestral Graph (PAG)
stages.input: Pivoted metric DataFrame for subgraph services (rows=time, cols=service); alpha=0.05
stages.output: PAGResult with variables, edges (DIRECTED/BIDIRECTED/PARTIALLY_DIRECTED/UNDIRECTED), adjacency_matrix, runtime_seconds
stages.latency_target: < 30s for k<=15 services (Fisher Z CI test)
stages.validation_check: PAGResult.n_variables == k; PAGResult is INTERVENTION-CONSISTENT (not causally accurate); SubgraphTooLargeError if k>15
stages.constraint: k <= max_variables=15; FCI is NOT run online for larger subgraphs
stages.notes: Uses causal-learn library. PAG is an equivalence class, not the true causal graph.

stages.description: Extract directed, bidirected, and partially-directed edges from PAGResult for downstream stages
stages.output: List[PAGEdge] partitioned into DIRECTED, BIDIRECTED, PARTIALLY_DIRECTED sets; hidden_confounder_pairs
stages.validation_check: All PAGEdge objects have valid edge_type; bidirected edges are flagged as potential hidden confounders

stages.description: Check causal identifiability for each directed PAG edge using backdoor/front-door criteria; RIFT abstains on NOT_IDENTIFIABLE pairs
stages.input: PAGResult; source/target variable pairs from directed PAG edges
stages.validation_check: NOT_IDENTIFIABLE pairs are excluded from intervention queue; RIFT abstains on those pairs
stages.notes: Full MAG-ID deferred. Phase 3 scope: backdoor + front-door only.

stages.description: Build InterventionCandidate objects for each identifiable service in anomaly subgraph
stages.input: Identifiable service list from IDENTIFIABILITY; anomaly scores; call graph
stages.output: List[InterventionCandidate] with service_id, variable, intervention_type, target_value, nominal_value
stages.validation_check: Each candidate has authorized=True or authorized=False; DENIED candidates excluded from MSIS input

stages.description: Greedy MSIS (Minimum Safe Intervention Set) approximation to select interventions minimising cumulative cost
stages.input: List[InterventionCost] from cost computation; candidate_posterior; theta_entropy=0.5; t_budget=600s
stages.output: MSISResult with selected_interventions, entropy_before/after, entropy_reduction, submodularity_verified, stopped_reason
stages.validation_check: All selected interventions are authorized; cumulative ED <= t_budget; submodularity_note records guarantee status

stages.description: Execute network interventions via tc u32 + per-destination netem; each intervention targets one destination IP
stages.output: List[NetworkInterventionRecord] with status APPLIED|FAILED|DRY_RUN; tc_handle, destination_ip
stages.validation_check: record.status == APPLIED (or DRY_RUN); tc commands logged; rollback path registered
stages.prerequisite: CAP_NET_ADMIN capability; Linux kernel; rift-eval-* namespace
stages.notes: dry_run=True on macOS. NEVER run against production without rift-eval-* namespace.

apply: tc qdisc add dev {iface} root handle 1: prio priomap ...
tc qdisc add dev {iface} parent 1:{handle} handle {handle}: netem delay {lat}ms {jitter}ms
tc filter add dev {iface} parent 1: protocol ip u32 match ip dst {dest_ip}/32 flowid 1:{handle}
rollback: tc filter del dev {iface} parent 1: protocol ip u32 match ip dst {dest_ip}/32 flowid 1:{handle}
tc qdisc del dev {iface} parent 1:{handle} handle {handle}:

stages.description: Run 5 validity checks on applied interventions to confirm clean experimental conditions
stages.output: Per-record validity check results: precision_check, clean_window, concurrent_event_free, recovery_confirmed, isolation_verified
stages.validation_check: All 5 checks pass; precision = |achieved - requested| / requested < 0.20; isolation_verified=True

validity_checks.2_clean_window: No concurrent incidents in observation window
validity_checks.3_concurrent_event_free: No other experiments active in cluster
validity_checks.4_recovery_confirmed: Rollback path confirmed; nominal state restored

stages.description: Collect post-intervention metrics from Prometheus for CID baseline comparison
stages.input: Same PrometheusClient or MockTelemetry; post-intervention window=60s
stages.output: Dict[service_id -> DataFrame] for post-intervention metric time series
stages.validation_check: n_post >= 20 (CANDIDATE grade floor) for CID to produce output; n_post >= 50 for RELIABLE grade

sample_tiers.CANDIDATE: 20 <= n < 50 — directional claim only, wide CI

stages.description: Compute Causal Intervention Divergence CID(X→Y, t) = W1(P(Y|baseline), P(Y|do(X:=x_nominal)))
stages.output: CIDResult with w1_estimate, w1_ci_lower/upper, tv_diagnostic, permutation_pvalue, grade, exceeds_threshold
stages.latency_target: ~30s for CANDIDATE (n=20-50, B=1000 permutations); ~120-300s for RELIABLE (n>=50, B=10000 permutations)
stages.validation_check: grade != INSUFFICIENT; permutation_pvalue computed; exceeds_threshold = (w1_estimate > theta_cid); theta_cid = 0.1 * IQR_baseline
stages.secondary_diagnostic: Total Variation (TV) — never used for attribution
stages.significance_test: Permutation test B=10000 alpha=0.05 (primary); bootstrap CI is effect-size only
stages.critical_note: CID > theta_cid does NOT by itself constitute causal attribution. EBD R1-R4 are all required.

stages.description: Evaluate Earliest Behavioral Divergence (R1-R4 criteria) for each candidate service
stages.input: Metric DataFrames; baselines; PAGResult; CID results; incident_window; delta_t=10s; theta_detect=3.0
stages.output: List[EBDResult] sorted by (DEFINITIVE first, earliest t_star, highest anomaly_score); confidence DEFINITIVE|CANDIDATE|NONE
stages.validation_check: DEFINITIVE requires r1+r2+r3+r4 all True; CANDIDATE requires r1+r2+r3; temporal precedence (R2) is primary sort key

criteria.R1: Observed behavioral deviation: delta_ik(t) > theta_detect for >= 2*delta_t
criteria.R2: Temporal precedence: t* < t_j for all j != i diverging (ties resolved by R3)
criteria.R3: Causal relevance: exists j s.t. V_j diverges AND V_i ->...-> V_j in G_T
criteria.R4: Intervention evidence: CID(V_i -> V_j, t*) > theta_cid for some downstream V_j

stages.critical_guarantee: A later large anomaly does NOT override an earlier causal divergence. R2 temporal precedence checked strictly.

stages.description: Update edge confidences and root-cause posterior using CID results (3-component closed-loop update)
stages.input: ClosedLoopState; CID result per (source, target) pair; alpha_confirm=0.2; alpha_weaken=0.1
stages.output: Updated ClosedLoopState with new edge_confidences, candidate_posterior, structure_changed flag
stages.validation_check: edge_confidences in [0.05, 0.95]; posterior sums to 1.0; structure_changed correctly reflects edge add/remove

components.component1: Edge confidence update: CID > theta_cid strengthens edge; CID <= theta_cid weakens
components.component2: Bayesian posterior update: Beta(3,1) for true cause, Beta(1,3) for non-cause
components.component3: Threshold-gated structure update: add/remove edges based on CID + confidence threshold

stages.description: Determine final attribution from top EBD candidate; apply identifiability constraints; RIFT abstains if confidence=NONE
stages.input: List[EBDResult] from EBD; identifiability results; boundary_limited flags
stages.validation_check: If abstained: attribution=None AND confidence=NONE; if DEFINITIVE: r1+r2+r3+r4 all True in top EBD
abstention_conditions: attribution_confidence == NONE (no EBD candidate satisfies R1-R3)
boundary_limited=True AND r4_pass=False (root may be outside subgraph, no CID confirmation)

stages.description: Evaluate four stopping conditions and decide whether to loop back to OBSERVE or terminate
stages.input: ClosedLoopState after GRAPH_UPDATE; iteration count; budget_remaining
stages.validation_check: stop_reason is set when should_stop=True; budget exhaustion checked FIRST (hard safety limit)
stages.next_state: OBSERVE (loop) if not stopping; STOP (terminal) if any condition met
